specs\Smoke\4-IssuedChecksSmoke.spec.ts
Issued Checks — Smoke > Grid
Grid loads with data rows and key column headers
Issued Checks — Smoke > Navigation
"+ Add Check" navigates to the add-check form
"Uploaded Checks" navigates to the uploads page
Issued Checks — Smoke > Toolbar
Search box filters grid and clears correctly
Excel export button is visible and enabled
Issued Checks — Smoke > Pagination
Page size change to 10 updates pagination info in bottom-right pager
Next page arrow advances to page 2
Last page arrow jumps to the final page
Typing a page number navigates to that page
Previous page button returns to page 1, First page button re-enables disabled state

Save a filter preset, verify it is auto-selected, then delete it
Issued Checks — Smoke > Saved Filters > Default Filter
Default filter auto-applies after logout and re-login
Issued Checks — Smoke > Sorting
Clicking a column header sorts ascending, clicking again sorts descending
Issued Checks — Smoke > Column Filter
Column filter popup applies a filter and Clear restores the full row set
Issued Checks — Smoke > Row Actions
"Edit" link on a row navigates to the check edit form
"View" (Change Log) link on a row navigates to the entity log
"Delete" on a row shows a confirm modal; Cancel dismisses it without deleting
Issued Checks — Smoke > Breadcrumb
Issued Checks breadcrumb link is visible on the page
